nodes.name: PlaybookLocalRepository.ts
nodes.summary: Persists locally staged playbook changes (adds/removes of standards, commands, skills) in a per-repository YAML file so the CLI playbook workflow can stage and later submit them.

nodes.name: PlaybookLocalRepository
nodes.summary: Class storing staged playbook changes in YAML keyed by normalized repo root, with add/remove/get/clear operations.

nodes.name: RepositoryTrackingGateway.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP gateway implementing IRepositoryTrackingGateway: gets, sets, updates branch and removes the tracked git repository for the authenticated organization via the Packmind API.

nodes.name: RepositoryTrackingGateway
nodes.summary: Gateway class calling tracked-repository API endpoints for the current organization.

nodes.name: SkillsGateway.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP gateway implementing ISkillsGateway to upload skills, fetch default skills and list skills by space through the Packmind API.

nodes.name: SkillsGateway
nodes.summary: Gateway class for skill upload, default skills retrieval and listing by space.

nodes.name: SpacesGateway.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP gateway implementing ISpacesGateway that resolves a space by slug for the authenticated organization.

nodes.name: SpacesGateway
nodes.summary: Gateway class fetching a space by slug from the API.

nodes.name: StandardsGateway.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP gateway implementing IStandardsGateway to create standards in a space, read/add rules and examples, and list standards by space.

nodes.name: StandardsGateway
nodes.summary: Gateway class for creating standards and managing their rules and examples.

nodes.name: agentHomeDirectory.ts
nodes.summary: Detects whether a project directory is an AI agent home directory (e.g. ~/.claude) and returns the path prefix to strip for home-level installs.

nodes.name: isAgentHomeDirectory
nodes.summary: Returns which agent (if any) owns the given directory as its home config dir, resolving symlinks.

nodes.name: getAgentHomeDirPrefix
nodes.summary: Returns the path prefix to strip for the given home agent.

nodes.name: binaryDetection.ts
nodes.summary: Detects binary files by known extension list and by null-byte inspection of file buffers, used when reading skill directories.

nodes.name: isBinaryExtension
nodes.summary: Checks a file path against a list of known binary extensions.

nodes.name: isBinaryBuffer
nodes.summary: Detects null bytes in a buffer sample to flag binary content.

nodes.name: isBinaryFile
nodes.summary: Combines extension and buffer checks to classify a file as binary.

nodes.name: consoleLogger.ts
nodes.summary: Central chalk-based console output helpers for the CLI: prefixed log/warn/info/error/success printers plus text formatters for slugs, paths, headers and commands; error output is recorded to avoid duplicate error logs.

nodes.name: logConsole
nodes.summary: Prints a plain message to the console with the CLI prefix.

nodes.name: logWarningConsole
nodes.summary: Prints a warning message to the console with the CLI prefix.

nodes.name: logInfoConsole
nodes.summary: Prints a info message to the console with the CLI prefix.

nodes.name: logErrorConsole
nodes.summary: Prints a error message to the console with the CLI prefix.

nodes.name: logSuccessConsole
nodes.summary: Prints a success message to the console with the CLI prefix.

nodes.name: formatSlug
nodes.summary: Chalk formatter for slug text.

nodes.name: formatLabel
nodes.summary: Chalk formatter for label text.

nodes.name: formatError
nodes.summary: Chalk formatter for error text.

nodes.name: formatWarning
nodes.summary: Chalk formatter for warning text.

nodes.name: formatBold
nodes.summary: Chalk formatter for bold text.

nodes.name: formatFilePath
nodes.summary: Chalk formatter for filepath text.

nodes.name: formatHeader
nodes.summary: Chalk formatter for header text.

nodes.name: formatCommand
nodes.summary: Chalk formatter for command text.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting credential providers (env and file), the CredentialsService, API key loading and decoding helpers.

nodes.name: credentialsLoader.ts
nodes.summary: Deprecated backward-compatibility shim re-exporting loadApiKey from the credentials module.

nodes.name: deployedFilesUtils.ts
nodes.summary: Helpers bridging the packmind lock file and the deployment API: converts lock entries to artifact versions, resolves render agents, fetches deployed file contents and remaps them for agent home-directory installs.

nodes.name: lockFileToArtifactVersionEntries
nodes.summary: Maps packmind lock file entries to artifact version entries for the deployment API.

nodes.name: resolveDeployedRenderAgents
nodes.summary: Determines which render agents to request from lock file and config.

nodes.name: fetchDeployedFiles
nodes.summary: Fetches currently deployed file contents for the lock file artifacts, remapping for home installs.

nodes.name: remapDeployedFilesForHomeInstall
nodes.summary: Rewrites deployed file paths and strips standard link footers when installing into an agent home dir.

nodes.name: diffFormatter.ts
nodes.summary: Formats a colored line-based unified diff between two content strings for CLI display.

nodes.name: formatContentDiff
nodes.summary: Produces a colored diff string between old and new content.

nodes.name: editorMessage.ts
nodes.summary: Opens the user's resolved text editor on a temp file to capture a multi-line message (e.g. change-proposal descriptions).

nodes.name: openEditorForMessage
nodes.summary: Spawns the resolved editor on a temp file and returns the edited message.

nodes.name: errorDiagnostics.ts
nodes.summary: Builds detailed diagnostics for errors (cause chains, network link descriptions, request context), wraps them into diagnostic errors and reports them once to the error log.

nodes.name: describeLink
nodes.summary: Describes a single error in the cause chain including network error codes.

nodes.name: causeChain
nodes.summary: Walks error.cause links into a list of descriptions.

nodes.name: buildErrorDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Builds a multi-line diagnostic report from an error and optional request context.

nodes.name: createDiagnosticError
nodes.summary: Creates a user-facing Error while logging full diagnostics to the error log.

nodes.name: reportError
nodes.summary: Logs an error with diagnostics to the error log once, marking it as reported.

nodes.name: errorLog.ts
nodes.summary: Manages the CLI error log file: rotation, deduplicated appends with invoked command and version metadata, and tracking of errors already reported to the user.

nodes.name: getErrorLogPath
nodes.summary: Returns the path to the CLI error log file.

nodes.name: invokedCommand
nodes.summary: Reconstructs the invoked CLI command line for log entries.

nodes.name: resetErrorLogDeduplication
nodes.summary: Resets in-memory deduplication state (used by tests).

nodes.name: isRestatementOf
nodes.summary: Checks whether a message merely restates an already-logged error.

nodes.name: appendErrorLog
nodes.summary: Appends a timestamped, deduplicated entry with diagnostics to the error log, rotating if oversized.

nodes.name: isReported
nodes.summary: Checks whether an error object was already reported.

nodes.name: markReported
nodes.summary: Marks an error (and primitives via message) as reported.

nodes.name: reportingSite
nodes.summary: Derives the caller site from a stack trace for recorded messages.

nodes.name: recordReportedMessage
nodes.summary: Records a message printed to the user so duplicate log entries are suppressed.

nodes.name: errorReporting.ts
nodes.summary: Higher-order wrapper that decorates handler functions so any thrown error (sync or async) is reported to the diagnostics log before rethrowing.
nodes.languageNotes: Handles both sync throws and rejected promises by inspecting the handler return value for a thenable.

nodes.name: withErrorReporting
nodes.summary: Wraps a handler so thrown or rejected errors are reported before propagating.
